info.title: Urja Meter Ops API Service
info.description: A high-performance, systematic RESTful API adapter over the legacy Urja Meter Ops portal. Powered by an in-memory query engine populated via HMAC-SHA256 signed bulk exports, supporting multi-attribute filtering, Haversine geospatial radius search, full grid hierarchy reconstruction, transformer telemetry aggregation, and automated data quality inspection.
